description: Elections Commission - Order to appoint Mr. Ihala Medagama Gamage Piyasena as a member of the Eight Parliament from Galle Electoral District No. 07
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy resulting from an election-related court judgment. It details the process under the Parliamentary Elections Act, including the declaration of a new elected Member of Parliament for the Galle Electoral District. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes, candidate eligibility, and the declaration of election results, which aligns perfectly with the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
